title: CFL ramp controls
overview: cflst, cfled, and ncfl define a linear CFL schedule used by the unstructured NS time-step path. Iteration::Init loads the start CFL, end CFL, ramp length, and optional dual-time mode (default 0). UTimeStep::CalcTimeStep updates the active CFL before selecting the CPU or supported HIP time-step path.
principle: For iteration i below ncfl, CFL(i) = cflst + (cfled - cflst) * i / ncfl. At and after ncfl, CFL is cfled. The selected iteration is outerSteps for physical-time stepping and innerSteps when the optional idualtime parameter is 1. This is a control schedule, not a direct physical time-step value.
architecture: Iteration::Init loads idualtime into Iteration::dualtime (default 0); TimeStep::CalcCfl selects the iteration counter through the pure CflIterationIndex policy and delegates interpolation to CflAtIteration. In the CPU path, timestepModel 0 computes local cell time steps from CFL-scaled spectral radii, timestepModel 1 fills cells with ctrl.pdt (loaded from global_dt), and the remaining branch computes local steps then uses the minimum as a common step and writes it back to ctrl.pdt. The supported HIP path is restricted to local timestepModel 0 and currently computes the inviscid local step.

proves: Iteration::Init reads cflst and cfled as Real values and ncfl as an integer.
UTimeStep::CalcTimeStep calls CalcCfl before the CPU/HIP time-step dispatch.
Iteration::Init loads optional idualtime into Iteration::dualtime with a default of zero, and TimeStep::CalcCfl selects outerSteps for physical-time stepping or innerSteps for dual-time stepping.
CflAtIteration linearly interpolates from cflst to cfled while iteration is less than ncfl and returns cfled at or beyond the ramp boundary.
The CPU local time-step policy uses CFL times cell volume divided by the cell spectral radius; an enabled viscous contribution is combined with the inviscid estimate using the harmonic formula.
The global timestepModel branch fills cell time steps from ctrl.pdt, which is initialized from global_dt; the local-global branch computes a local minimum and stores it in ctrl.pdt.
CflIterationIndex selects the outer iteration for physical-time stepping and the inner iteration for dual-time stepping.
does_not_prove: An admissible range, positivity rule, or validation policy for cflst, cfled, or ncfl.
That every solver or every time integration mode uses this unstructured NS time-step path.
That a selected CFL value guarantees stability, convergence, or a particular physical accuracy.
That global_dt is derived from the CFL ramp in timestepModel 1.
That the supported HIP time-step path includes the viscous contribution.
